titulo_es: Condicionales sin if (inversión y conectores condicionales)
descripcion_es: Had I known…, Should you need…, Were it not for…, provided that, unless, as long as, otherwise.
resumen: En registro formal, if puede suprimirse invirtiendo should, were o had con el sujeto. Además, hay conectores que sustituyen a if con matices propios: unless, provided that, as long as, on condition that, otherwise, but for.

filas: If you should need help, call me.
Should you need help, call me.
Primer condicional, posibilidad remota y cortés
If I were in your position, I'd resign.
Were I in your position, I'd resign.
Segundo condicional
If it were not for your help, we'd fail.
Were it not for your help, we'd fail.
Segundo condicional con «de no ser por»
If we had known, we would have come.
Had we known, we would have come.
Tercer condicional
If it had not been for the rain, we'd have won.
Had it not been for the rain, we'd have won.
Tercer condicional con «de no haber sido por»

items: La negación no se contrae en la inversión: Had I not seen it (no «Hadn't I seen it»).
Con verbos distintos de be en segundo condicional se usa were + to: Were the price to rise, sales would fall.
But for + sustantivo equivale a were it not for / had it not been for: But for the storm, we would have arrived on time.

filas: unless
a menos que, si no
I won't go unless you come with me.
provided (that) / providing (that)
siempre que, con tal de que
You can borrow it provided you return it tomorrow.
as long as / so long as
mientras, siempre que
As long as you're honest, I'll help you.
on condition that
con la condición de que
He agreed on condition that his name was not published.
otherwise
de lo contrario
Hurry up; otherwise we'll miss the bus.
supposing / suppose
suponiendo que, ¿y si…?
Supposing it rains, what will we do?
in case
por si (no es condicional)
Take an umbrella in case it rains.

explicacion.texto: Ojo: unless ya contiene la negación (= if… not), así que no se combina con otra negación con el mismo sentido. Y in case no significa «en caso de que» condicional, sino «por si acaso»: se toma la precaución antes.

ejemplos.frase: Should you have any questions, please contact our office.
ejemplos.traduccion: Si tuviera alguna pregunta, póngase en contacto con nuestra oficina.

ejemplos.frase: Had I known about the strike, I would have taken the car.
ejemplos.traduccion: De haber sabido lo de la huelga, habría cogido el coche.

ejemplos.frase: Were it not for her patience, the project would have collapsed long ago.
ejemplos.traduccion: De no ser por su paciencia, el proyecto se habría venido abajo hace tiempo.

ejemplos.frase: You may keep the dog provided that you walk it every day.
ejemplos.traduccion: Puedes quedarte con el perro siempre que lo saques a pasear todos los días.

ejemplos.frase: Unless the weather improves, the match will be cancelled.
ejemplos.traduccion: A menos que mejore el tiempo, se suspenderá el partido.

ejemplos.frase: But for his quick reaction, there would have been an accident.
ejemplos.traduccion: De no ser por su rápida reacción, habría habido un accidente.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: Hadn't I missed the train, I would have arrived on time.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: Had I not missed the train, I would have arrived on time.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: En la inversión condicional la negación va sin contraer y detrás del sujeto.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: I'll take a coat in case it will be cold.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: I'll take a coat in case it is cold.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Tras in case (y tras unless, provided…) no se usa will para el futuro.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Unless ya significa «si no»; añadir otra negación invierte el sentido.

ejercicios.frase: ___ you require further information, do not hesitate to contact us.
respuestas: Should
ejercicios.explicacion: Should + sujeto sustituye a if en un condicional abierto y cortés.

ejercicios.frase: ___ I known you were ill, I would have visited you.
respuestas: Had
ejercicios.explicacion: Tercer condicional sin if: had + sujeto + participio.

ejercicios.frase: You can stay out late ___ you phone us when you leave.
respuestas: as long as
ejercicios.explicacion: As long as introduce la condición que debe cumplirse (siempre que).

ejercicios.frase: Write the number down ___ you forget it.
respuestas: in case
ejercicios.explicacion: In case expresa una precaución: «por si se te olvida».

ejercicios.frase: ___ it not for the scholarship, she could not afford university.
respuestas: Were
ejercicios.explicacion: Were it not for = if it were not for (de no ser por), segundo condicional.

ejercicios.frase: We will not sign the contract ___ they lower the price.
respuestas: unless
until
ejercicios.explicacion: Unless = if… not: no firmaremos si no bajan el precio (until, «hasta que», también es correcto).

ejercicios.frase: Leave now; ___ you will get stuck in traffic.
respuestas: otherwise
ejercicios.explicacion: Otherwise = de lo contrario, si no lo haces.

ejercicios.frase: ___ for the firefighters, the whole building would have burnt down.
respuestas: But
ejercicios.explicacion: But for + sustantivo = de no haber sido por.

ejercicios.frase: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
respuestas: Were I you, I would accept the offer.
Were I you, I'd accept the offer.

ejercicios.frase: If they had not helped us, we would have failed.
respuestas: Had they not helped us, we would have failed.
Had they not helped us, we'd have failed.
ejercicios.explicacion: Tercer condicional negativo: had + sujeto + not + participio, sin contracción.

ejercicios.enunciado: Reescribe sin if, usando inversión con should.
ejercicios.frase: If the flight is delayed, we will inform passengers by text.
respuestas: Should the flight be delayed, we will inform passengers by text.
Should the flight be delayed, we'll inform passengers by text.
ejercicios.explicacion: Should + sujeto + verbo base (be) sustituye a if + presente.

ejercicios.frase: Hadn't she called, we would have waited all night.
respuestas: Had she not called, we would have waited all night.
ejercicios.explicacion: En la inversión, la negación no se contrae: had she not.

ejercicios.frase: I'll lend you the car provided that you will drive carefully.
respuestas: I'll lend you the car provided that you drive carefully.
I will lend you the car provided that you drive carefully.
ejercicios.explicacion: Tras provided that se usa presente con valor de futuro, no will.

respuestas: Should you change your mind let me know
ejercicios.explicacion: Should + sujeto + verbo base, seguido de la oración principal.

respuestas: Were the government to raise taxes consumption would fall
ejercicios.explicacion: Were + sujeto + to + infinitivo para un segundo condicional con verbo distinto de be.
